value_or_distribution: lognormal; median scaled to year (2026 real terms ~ THB 65,000 = 1 baht-weight); sigma=0.9
rationale: Right-skew informed by wealth concentration (S07); median anchored to affordability of 1 baht-weight bar at the cohort year's observed prices; NOT an empirical measurement of Thai gold investors
impact_if_wrong: Changes distribution of position sizes and P&L dispersion

value_or_distribution: Beta(a=2,b=2) scaled to [0.3,0.9] of initial capital deployed to gold at start; remainder cash
rationale: No direct evidence; keeps cash buffer consistent with retail behaviour; bounds avoid degenerate all-cash portfolios
Bars dominate investment demand in WGC country data (S01-S03); ornaments additionally culturally held; exact investor-level split unknown
impact_if_wrong: Changes spread cost profile (ornament spread much larger)

value_or_distribution: ornament_buy = bar_buy + delta; delta ~ Uniform(0,200) THB/baht-weight (default 100)
rationale: Scraped archive lacks ornament buy-back quote (S10); anchored so that ornament buy-back sits between bar buy-back and tax base; alternative convention: shops pay tax-base value
impact_if_wrong: Directly changes ornament realized P&L and loss magnitude

value_or_distribution: equal-weight across 8 archetypes in baseline; configurable
rationale: No empirical Thai investor distribution exists (parameter_evidence: transaction_frequency gap); equal weights avoid false calibration; sensitivity varies weights
impact_if_wrong: Changes aggregate turnover and cost drag

value_or_distribution: monthly decision grid per portfolio (random day-of-month); trigger rules evaluated on daily closes before decision time
rationale: Discrete decision points approximate retail checking frequency; no-look-ahead enforced

value_or_distribution: buy_dip triggers when current bar sell price <= 97% of trailing 90-day max close
rationale: Qualitative support only (S06 dip-buying evidence); threshold arbitrary within plausible band
impact_if_wrong: Affects entry timing and returns of dip archetype

value_or_distribution: buy_momentum triggers when 20-day MA > 60-day MA of bar sell prices
rationale: Standard technical rule; no Thai-specific calibration exists

value_or_distribution: liquidity_sale archetype: Poisson shock with lambda=0.02 per month; sells all gold and withdraws proceeds
rationale: Emergency sale archetype must exist for loss explanations; rate arbitrary

value_or_distribution: explicit fees = 0 THB in baseline (all cost embedded in dealer spread observed in quotes)
rationale: GTA quotes already embed the spread; separate published commission evidence unavailable
Retail bars trade in whole baht-weight (15.244 g) units per market convention (S11)
Ornaments are divisible by design but quoted per baht-weight; half-unit approximates gram-level divisibility

value_or_distribution: portfolio established on start date with observed quotes that day (no unobserved historical cost basis)
rationale: Spec 6.4: avoid assigning unobserved historical cost basis; start-in-cash and start-in-gold variants

value_or_distribution: Modified Dietz for annual returns; TWR across flow-adjusted subperiods as secondary
rationale: Event-level valuations support flow-adjusted returns; spec 9.5 requirement
impact_if_wrong: Small numeric differences in reported returns

value_or_distribution: monthly equity marks within calendar year (daily optional via config)
rationale: Spec 12.5 allows monthly default to control output size
impact_if_wrong: Larger MDD slightly with daily marks
